children: is raising prices on several of its streaming plans, with customers set to be notified as early as Wednesday, Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter. The ad-free Disney+ plan will rise 13%, or $2.50, to $21.49 a month. Disney shares were unchanged as of 12:00 p.m. ET.

Ad-free Hulu goes up by the same $2.50, but the ad-free Disney+ and Hulu bundle rises only $2 to $21.99, just 50 cents more than either service on its own. On the ad-supported side, standalone Disney+ and Hulu plans each rise 50 cents to $12.49, while the ad-supported bundle stays at $12.99.
Even after the increase, ad-free Disney+ stays below the $26.99 a month Netflix

charges for its ad-free plan with 4K and multiple-device access. The move comes a week after Disney named Karandeep Anand as its first chief technology officer and put Adam Smith in charge of its streaming business, as it sharpens its focus on Disney+ and Hulu.

title: Disney's Price Hike Makes the Bundle the Obvious Buy
